Translations.MAJTEXT_LIST_INPUT_HINT:
Press Select P1 (or touch secondary screen) to search and sort songs, long press to refresh the song list. Touch the song cover for random selection. 
Long press key 4 to start practice mode. Long press key 5 to logout. Press Alt+Enter to toggle full-screen mode. Press Alt+F4 to exit the game.
